figures.caption: Figure 2: Runtimes across five matched trials for redundancy (a)–(e) and union information (f)– (j). Crosses mark a 300-s timeout in at least one BROJA trial. Methods: Newton: optimization of Eqs. (8) and (12) using Newton–PCG; Fastpath: two-source redundancy shortcut with Newton fallback; Closed form: two-source union formula from Theorem 4. BROJA (Newton): Newton–PCG implementation of the BROJA source-covariance optimization (Venkatesh et al., 2023; Zhao et al., 2025). Panels (a,f) vary source and target dimensions together; (b,g) vary the first source dimension d1 (dY = d2 = 8); (c,h) vary both source dimensions d1 = d2 (dY = 8); (d,i) vary the target dimension dY (d1 = d2 = 64); (e,j) vary the source count n (dY = di = 8). Details in Sec. S3.5.
